name: Clause 1.1 — Standardised Throughput
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: every department is to post 50% more output, effective retroactively.

name: Clause 1.2 — Throughput, Revised
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: the previous throughput figure was a typo. Double it.

name: Clause 1.3 — Throughput, Final
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: output is now tripled. There will be no Clause 1.4. There is always a Clause 1.4.

name: Clause 2.1 — Generous Sealing
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: the Seal press has been recalibrated. Audits now pay half again as much.

name: Clause 2.2 — Sealing, Industrial
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: a second Seal press has been requisitioned. Audits pay double.

name: Clause 3.1 — The Night Shift, Formalised
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: the building is now open for a further 24 hours of unattended work.

name: Clause 4.1 — Stationery, Reallocated
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: the voucher budget has been found. It was behind the cabinet. Grants are up 50%.

name: Clause 5.1 — The Valhalla Accord
desc: Memo from Cosmic Restructuring: a northern annex has agreed to file paperwork. Terms were mead.
